excluded.AI systems as agents: Owner's scope for this case: capability is a stock, not an actor.
excluded.evaluator's other clients: One evaluator, these two labs only.
excluded.misuse by third parties: Catastrophe risk depends only on the safety gap.
excluded.other labs and countries: Two labs under one state; no jurisdiction shopping.
excluded.proliferation and open release: Deployment is one lab's act; copies and leaks are not modeled.
excluded.recall: A deployment cannot be undone; with continuous oversight the state can halt a deployed lab's scaling, not withdraw it.
excluded.the state's own capture: Only the evaluator channel is modeled; lobbying of the state is not.

safe progress blocked.description: A halt stopped a deployment or scaling that would have kept the lab within the margin.

unsafe deployment.description: A deployed lab's capability exceeds its safety by more than the margin.

stakeholders.future people: People after the horizon. No agent.
stakeholders.public: Everyone exposed to a catastrophe now. No agent.
stakeholders.state: The government that licenses or halts; an agent.
stakeholders.users: People who would use a deployed system. No agent.

fixed_reasons.base: Trailing lab's starting capability; the lead is swept. Safety starts at zero for both.
fixed_reasons.cap: Capability and safety ceiling keeping the state space finite; runs that reach it show it.
fixed_reasons.node_budget: Per-decision work cap, as in the other worlds. Exhaustion is unresolved, not an outcome.

rules.licensing:
Labs keep within the margin (secure when over it) and deploy only after a pass on
    record; otherwise they scale while within the margin. The evaluator reports strictly.
    The state halts any undeployed lab without a pass on record and, under continuous
    oversight, any deployed lab whose last report failed.
rules.licensing (paid):
Licensing with side payments (engine/transfers.py). The designated payer (the state
    if it may pay the evaluator, otherwise the labs) pays the evaluator the first declared
    amount each round; nobody pays anything else. The state also halts a lab seen paying the
    evaluator anything it was not designated to pay.
rules.race:
No regime: labs deploy at once and then scale; the evaluator reports strictly; the
    state allows everything.
